verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both are broken in the same ways. The woman-in-robe hero photo has shrunk to a small thumbnail in the bottom-left corner and the rest of the canvas is plain white. The tape strips float far above the note card, detached from it. The checkmarks no longer line up with the list items: there are 6 ticks for 3 merged lines such as 'Chin Upper lip Ears'. MUSELIO.PT is wedged beside $50 instead of signing off at the bottom. A is slightly worse because its tape strip covers more of the tiny photo; B's smaller tape hides less of it.
